axes.question: Should I work at fixing myself or accept myself as I am?
axes.x_advice: Examine yourself often and make small, steady improvements every day, because they add up over time.
axes.y_advice: Stop forcing yourself to change; see yourself clearly and kindly, and change comes from that awareness.

axes.question: Should I step away from the world to grow spiritually?
axes.x_advice: Withdraw into solitude and silence to meditate, and keep away from worldly company and distractions.
axes.y_advice: Do your inner work in the middle of family life, work and duties, not by leaving them behind.

axes.question: When someone wrongs me, should I forgive or answer fairly?
axes.x_advice: Let go of grudges and do good even to those who harm you, since hatred never ends hatred.
axes.y_advice: Repay kindness with kindness and injury with fairness, rather than rewarding wrongdoing with generosity.

axes.question: Is it ever right to use force or fight?
axes.x_advice: Practice nonviolence in thought, word and deed, and resist wrong only by peaceful means.
axes.y_advice: When duty calls, resist wrongdoers with force and face danger bravely rather than give in to cowardice.

axes.question: Should I keep set rituals and rules of conduct?
axes.x_advice: Follow the rites and standards handed down by the wise, since they shape and order your desires.
axes.y_advice: Do not depend on rituals or rulebooks; a sincere heart and good judgment matter more.

axes.question: Should I trust teachers and scripture or question everything?
axes.x_advice: Read scripture daily and value the word of a true teacher, which awakens you to what is real.
axes.y_advice: Do not accept any teaching on authority; test it against your own reason and experience.

axes.question: When someone I love dies, should I grieve?
axes.x_advice: Let grief come and honor the dead with proper mourning, but keep it within reasonable bounds.
axes.y_advice: Do not weep or mourn, since death is natural and the true self is never destroyed.

axes.question: Should I think about my own death often?
axes.x_advice: Remember each day that you may die soon, and let that push you to live well now.
axes.y_advice: Do not torment yourself preparing for death; when the time comes, nature will show you how.

axes.question: How much should I care about my honor and reputation?
axes.x_advice: Prize your honor and good name, and never trade them away for comfort or gain.
axes.y_advice: Stop seeking approval or fame; decide your own worth and care little what others think.

axes.question: Should I choose work I love or work that's needed?
axes.x_advice: Find out what you love to do and do it, rather than choosing work for money or status.
axes.y_advice: Treat work as doing what others and society need, and do your duty well whatever you feel.

axes.question: Should I enjoy pleasures like drink and sex in moderation?
axes.x_advice: Enjoy food, drink and bodily pleasures moderately, keeping a middle path between indulgence and harshness.
axes.y_advice: Give up drink and sensual indulgence altogether, and practice strict restraint to grow in spirit.

axes.question: Should I welcome arguments or avoid them?
axes.x_advice: Welcome contradiction and frank debate in conversation, and settle disagreements by open discussion.
axes.y_advice: Avoid arguing; choose kindness over being right, since winning an argument loses goodwill.

axes.question: Should I point out other people's faults or mind my own?
axes.y: Look only at your own faults
axes.x_advice: When someone goes wrong, tell them kindly and at the right moment, so they can accept the correction and improve.
axes.y_advice: Leave others' faults alone and examine your own failings, since that is the only conduct you can truly change.

axes.question: Is happiness found in quiet solitude or in serving others?
axes.x_advice: Find your happiness in useful work and in serving others, since contributing to people gives life its value.
axes.y_advice: Learn to sit quietly alone in a room, since restless craving for activity causes most human unhappiness.

axes.question: When life goes against me, accept it or keep pushing?
axes.x_advice: Accept whatever happens as part of the larger order, and stop resisting events you cannot control.
axes.y_advice: Persist in your purpose through opposition and setbacks, because human effort, not fate, decides success.

axes.question: Should I be content with my life or stay dissatisfied?
axes.x_advice: Cultivate gratitude and contentment with what you have, rather than dwelling on what you lack.
axes.y_advice: Do not let comfort and respectability smother your discontent; it is what keeps you growing.

axes.question: Should I learn mainly from books or from looking inward?
axes.x_advice: Treasure learning as your true wealth; study widely and combine it with thought to apply it to your life.
axes.y_advice: Seek self-knowledge and look for principle in your own mind rather than relying on books and experts.

axes.question: Can I trust it when people show gratitude?
axes.x_advice: Never forget a kindness done to you, however small, and live with a grateful heart.
axes.y_advice: Do not take gratitude at face value; it is often just a hope of receiving greater favors.

axes.question: Should I give people everything they want from me?
axes.x_advice: Make people depend on you rather than satisfying them fully, so they keep valuing what you offer.
axes.y_advice: Give and love generously and openly, without holding back, since giving enriches rather than impoverishes.

axes.question: Does a higher power take part in my life?
axes.x_advice: Do not fear the gods; they do not interfere in human affairs, so live free of that dread.
axes.y_advice: Accept your trials as part of the divine plan and rely on grace, not merely your own merit.

axes.question: Should I raise children strictly or with lots of encouragement?
axes.x_advice: Educate children early and strictly, disciplining them while young rather than spoiling them.
axes.y_advice: Encourage and affirm children and use praise rather than punishment, because belief in them shapes who they become.

axes.question: When troubling thoughts come, watch them or turn elsewhere?
axes.x_advice: Let thoughts come and go while you watch them calmly, without identifying with them or following them.
axes.y_advice: Stop dwelling on yourself; turn your attention outward toward other people or a task at hand.

axes.question: Should I embrace this world or detach from it?
axes.x_advice: Seek the infinite through the finite world and treasure its fleeting things, which make life precious.
axes.y_advice: See the world's pleasures as passing illusion and free yourself from them for what lies beyond.

axes.question: How much of my time should go to earning a living?
axes.x_advice: Do some physical labor every day to earn your bread honestly rather than living idly.
axes.y_advice: Arrange your shelter and food simply and cheaply so you need work only a few weeks a year.
